PublishedFakeRegistry: compare raw descriptor inside same shared bus publication boundary used by every composed fake writer; refuse before append, append before infallible raw mutation, broadcast after. Same event timestamp/reason semantics as existing unconditional path.

Raw FakeRegistry: compare and mutate under one RegistryState mutex; refused calls do not advance fake sequence. Guarded tombstone clears native-delivery attestation. Deterministic raw fake timestamp remains its sequence, as with existing raw fake contract.

Guard is explicitly a one-directional safety brake: removing it permits more requested tombstones; it does not decide liveness, retention or which seat should be reaped.
